evidence:
Required empirical ranking evidence is missing; source arithmetic is monotone and no concrete ranking inversion was established. I read the actual frozen XLSX with openpyxl: Quality Checks row 43 (check 42) says "A worse app never outscores a better one" and names weights/gates/criteria; Internal Quality Checks row 43 says this needs monitoring. The frozen skill references/quality-checks.md:172-173 requires checking gates and weights for inverted ordering. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:31 and qc/README.md:25-27 separately require real, hash-bound reward-ordering logs; no runtime-evidence.json exists in this run.

Mathematical/source half: frozen task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 has zero-weight render/constraints gates, Functional/Polish/Visual 0.6/0.2/0.2 and functional floor 0.05. task/tests/tools/score.py:41,46-48 applies gate conjunction, positive weighted mean, strict floor and four-decimal rounding. For valid completed score vectors, R=0 if either gate fails or F<=0.05; otherwise R=round(0.6F+0.2P+0.2V,4). This is coordinatewise nondecreasing, with possible ties from the floor/rounding. Parsing every judge.toml found 58 Functional criteria with total positive weight 32.7 (range 0.10-2.75), seven Polish criteria totalling 4.0 (0.25-1.0), six Visual criteria totalling 6.0 (all 1.0), and one binary criterion in each all_pass gate. Visual's stated (raw-1)/4 normalization is increasing. Functional owns 60%, more than all craft/usability shares combined. test.sh:212-227 runs gates and score.py before the scored suite. No task-specific negative-weight or gate-reward inversion was found.

Executed read-only arithmetic check: imported the actual frozen score.py with bytecode disabled; supplied suite JSON and captured output through in-memory path/read stubs, leaving source and logs untouched. Evaluated 700 vectors over render/constraints={0,1}, F={0,.0499,.05,.0501,.1,.5,1}, P,V={0,.25,.5,.75,1}. All 2,420 adjacent coordinate increases were nondecreasing (zero violations). At P=V=1 the floor jump is 0 at F=.05 to .4301 at F=.0501: a nondecreasing canonical discontinuity, not evidence of a ranking inversion. Synthetic vectors test arithmetic, not how the configured judge scores applications.

Semantic challenges: the conforming alternative of a server-rendered library with different controls/routes is expressly accepted by Constraints judge.toml (description: "whether delivered in an application data response or a server-rendered document" and "Do not require a separate JSON/list endpoint"); visual prompts accept simple/native layouts. A missing Auto-run convenience control cannot zero unrelated gates by app_context.md:16. The broken candidate that never runs timers cannot gain cancellation credit: Functional prompt S04 requires the uncancelled four-second callback actually to fire; S17 likewise requires successful automatic execution before either off-state negative. The shared-scenario contract and app_context.md:24 preserve independently observed sibling credit. These source challenges did not produce a demonstrated false fail or false pass; none was executed as a judged app comparison.

Actual evidence limitation: golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json:2-5 identifies case=golden, paid_provider=false and direct pinned Playwright; :1409 and :6152 say criterion_verdicts_produced=false, and :10432-10433 report 98.0268 seconds and oracle_score_claimed=false. Its raw restart fact preserves Primary id 3/revision 2 and Second id 4/revision 1; its stale-save fact records an otherwise valid revision-1 request rejected with 409 while revision-2 fields remain unchanged. These are useful product observations, not reward rankings. I checked the executed launch_workflow.py and run_workflow.cjs, verified all recorded driver/app hashes, confirmed current Functional prompt/rubric hashes, and compared every frozen task file with manifest.json (zero mismatches). The initial 070305 result is also a golden-only unpaid run, passed=false, and claims no Oracle score. Neither available run supplies configured-judge dimension rewards for a strictly degraded app versus its stronger control, nor an actual cross-app ordering. Therefore the runtime half remains unmeasured despite the successful arithmetic check; this row cannot be Pass.
suggested_fix: When provider execution is authorized and available, run the unchanged configured verifier on this exact candidate and controlled strictly degraded app variants with other dimensions held equal; retain per-criterion and dimension scores plus actual commands/log hashes in runtime-evidence.json under reward_ranking_is_monotone. Reconcile any observed inversion. Do not change canonical weights, gates or harness to satisfy this evidence gap.
